v4-4.candidate: I said, ‘I will uncover your ear,’ saying, ‘Acquire it before those who sit here and before the elders of my people.’ If you will act as next of kin, do so; but if you will not act as next of kin, tell me, and I shall know. For there is no one besides you to act as next of kin, and I come after you.” He said, “I am he; I will act as next of kin.”
